set.body: After Gate G, establish reproducible semantic admission courts and iteratively eliminate every material end-to-end loss against correct, deliberately aligned graph-kernel implementations. Own measured bottlenecks across Grakern, Graph4s, and Gale. No semantic weakening, hidden conversion costs, incomparable warmup boundaries, or aggregate score may hide a losing row. The epic closes only after the performance gate certifies the declared Tier-1 championship.
set.title: Performance supremacy: correctness-locked cross-library race
